Minutes and Agendas

		
    
                    


    



Ordinary meetings of Council are usually held on the fourth Thursday of each month at 6pm All meetings are to be held in the Court House Circle Street, New Norfolk (behind the Council Chambers) unless noted otherwise. You can view upcoming meeting dates here.
Meeting Agendas 
Agendas are available on the page below 5 days prior to the date of the meeting. Agendas are provided as PDF documents which may be read directly from the link on electronic devices such as smart phones and iPads. They may also be downloaded and printed at home.
Requesting a printed copy of the agenda
Printed copies are available from customer service upon request. Requests can be made via phone on 03 6261 8500, email to dvcouncil@dvc.tas.gov.au or in person during our office hours of  9:00am to 4:00pm Monday to Friday. It is preferred that requests include the Agenda item/s you are interested in to be printed, however entire Agendas may be requested if required. Requests require at least 1 business day notice.  A new request is required for each meeting.
Printed Agendas can be picked up between 12:00pm on the day after the Agenda is made available on this page, up until 4:00pm on the day of the council meeting.  They will not be available before this period. Any agendas not collected by 4:00pm on the day of the Council meeting will be taken to the meeting in an envelope with the requestor's name on it for collection at 5:45pm.
Meeting Minutes
Please note that the minutes of the previous months Council meeting will not be uploaded to our web page until they have been confirmed at the next meeting of Council.
Policies  relating to meetings
The Council adopted an Audio Recording Policy to record the open meetings of Council (as at April 2025).  These recordings will be maintained on file for a period of twelve months from the date of the meeting.
The Council adopted a Public Question Time Policy (as at November 2020) to provide a framework for members of the public to ask questions relating to Council activities at ordinary council meetings in accordance with the Local Government (Meeting Procedures) Regulations 2025.
If you have any questions regarding Council's Agendas and Minutes please contact dvcouncil@dvc.tas.gov.au or telephone (03) 6261 8500.

Minutes and Agendas

		
    
                    


    



Ordinary meetings of Council are usually held on the fourth Thursday of each month at 6pm All meetings are to be held in the Court House Circle Street, New Norfolk (behind the Council Chambers) unless noted otherwise. You can view upcoming meeting dates here.
Meeting Agendas 
Agendas are available on the page below 5 days prior to the date of the meeting. Agendas are provided as PDF documents which may be read directly from the link on electronic devices such as smart phones and iPads. They may also be downloaded and printed at home.
Requesting a printed copy of the agenda
Printed copies are available from customer service upon request. Requests can be made via phone on 03 6261 8500, email to dvcouncil@dvc.tas.gov.au or in person during our office hours of  9:00am to 4:00pm Monday to Friday. It is preferred that requests include the Agenda item/s you are interested in to be printed, however entire Agendas may be requested if required. Requests require at least 1 business day notice.  A new request is required for each meeting.
Printed Agendas can be picked up between 12:00pm on the day after the Agenda is made available on this page, up until 4:00pm on the day of the council meeting.  They will not be available before this period. Any agendas not collected by 4:00pm on the day of the Council meeting will be taken to the meeting in an envelope with the requestor's name on it for collection at 5:45pm.
Meeting Minutes
Please note that the minutes of the previous months Council meeting will not be uploaded to our web page until they have been confirmed at the next meeting of Council.
Policies  relating to meetings
The Council adopted an Audio Recording Policy to record the open meetings of Council (as at April 2025).  These recordings will be maintained on file for a period of twelve months from the date of the meeting.
The Council adopted a Public Question Time Policy (as at November 2020) to provide a framework for members of the public to ask questions relating to Council activities at ordinary council meetings in accordance with the Local Government (Meeting Procedures) Regulations 2025.
If you have any questions regarding Council's Agendas and Minutes please contact dvcouncil@dvc.tas.gov.au or telephone (03) 6261 8500.

Minutes and Agendas

		
    
                    


    



Ordinary meetings of Council are usually held on the fourth Thursday of each month at 6pm All meetings are to be held in the Court House Circle Street, New Norfolk (behind the Council Chambers) unless noted otherwise. You can view upcoming meeting dates here.
Meeting Agendas 
Agendas are available on the page below 5 days prior to the date of the meeting. Agendas are provided as PDF documents which may be read directly from the link on electronic devices such as smart phones and iPads. They may also be downloaded and printed at home.
Requesting a printed copy of the agenda
Printed copies are available from customer service upon request. Requests can be made via phone on 03 6261 8500, email to dvcouncil@dvc.tas.gov.au or in person during our office hours of  9:00am to 4:00pm Monday to Friday. It is preferred that requests include the Agenda item/s you are interested in to be printed, however entire Agendas may be requested if required. Requests require at least 1 business day notice.  A new request is required for each meeting.
Printed Agendas can be picked up between 12:00pm on the day after the Agenda is made available on this page, up until 4:00pm on the day of the council meeting.  They will not be available before this period. Any agendas not collected by 4:00pm on the day of the Council meeting will be taken to the meeting in an envelope with the requestor's name on it for collection at 5:45pm.
Meeting Minutes
Please note that the minutes of the previous months Council meeting will not be uploaded to our web page until they have been confirmed at the next meeting of Council.
Policies  relating to meetings
The Council adopted an Audio Recording Policy to record the open meetings of Council (as at April 2025).  These recordings will be maintained on file for a period of twelve months from the date of the meeting.
The Council adopted a Public Question Time Policy (as at November 2020) to provide a framework for members of the public to ask questions relating to Council activities at ordinary council meetings in accordance with the Local Government (Meeting Procedures) Regulations 2025.
If you have any questions regarding Council's Agendas and Minutes please contact dvcouncil@dvc.tas.gov.au or telephone (03) 6261 8500.

Derwent Valley Council

    

        Council envisions that by working together, the Derwent Valley will become known for the beauty of its preserved natural environment and the produce and lifestyle it provides  for a prosperous and proud community. 
        
At Council, we aim to live our values of Quality Service, Collaboration, Growth, Integrity and Wellbeing in everything we do.
